mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 5.5% in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing output contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increase above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In slow growth economies (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines in slow growth economies, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.
